title: feat(studio): the Studio menu draws no datasource row, and ADR-0084 writes it as a no-row entry
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-tesla"} -->
_Requested by **Tesla** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01AXsQkLFKRdQCqQ3RTr6Jao?thread=cmsg_01AXsQkLFKRdQCqQ3RTr6JaoCsxJcMyC43e5vqVhNB7PYu)_

Fixes #37920

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 用户能看到什么变化：App Studio 左侧菜单「平台」组里不再有「数据源」这一行，⌘K 搜索面板里也没有了；数据源只在「设置 › 集成」里管。「全部类型」目录仍列数据源，点开去设置。
- 为什么做：App Studio 改版专题里你的决定 12：连接是绑在环境上的配置，归设置管，Studio 只开发软件包。
- 出错会怎样：只少画菜单里的一行，不动数据、不动设置页，直接撤回即可恢复。
- 要你做什么：这个 PR 改了受管文档（架构决策记录 ADR-0084 的类型表一行），审核通过后请你或 os-zhuang 批准合并。

## What changes

- **The menu draws no `datasource` row, in any scope.** `studioMenuPlacement.ts` drops the row and adds `STUDIO_MENU_NO_ROW_TYPES = {'datasource'}`; `buildStudioMenu` skips a type in that set before it places anything, on a package, on `~org` and on `~all`. Removing the placement row alone would not do it: the menu's own rule draws a type with no row in 高级 at the end of its group ("never invisible", objectstack#37201), so the no-row set is the exception that rule now names.
- **Retired, because they served only that row:** the `datasource` branch of `typeEntryPath` (it routed the row to Setup's Datasources page) with its `SETUP_DATASOURCES_PATH` import, and the row's `Database` icon in `StudioMenu.tsx`.
- **The ⌘K palette follows.** It lists the menu's own entries (`buildStudioMenu`), so its `type:datasource` entry goes too; `StudioPaletteGroups.surfaceScope-36900.test.tsx` is re-pointed.
- **What stays, and why:** `SETUP_DATASOURCES_PATH` (the directory tile and the area's `datasource/*` redirect read it); `STUDIO_PALETTE_ITEMLESS_TYPES` (the palette's item reads still run over the directory-scoped types, which include `datasource`, so it still keeps the palette from reading datasource items; only its docblock changes); the type's `system` registration; `HIDDEN_DIRECTORY_TYPES` (untouched).
- **ADR-0084, the type → group table:** the `datasource` row becomes a no-row entry like `field`'s (`| — |` for Order and Tier, last in its group), `external_catalog` moves from 7 to 6, and one dated note under the table names this card. 平台 Platform still counts 7 table rows (six with an order, and `datasource`), so no count changes. Drafted by an isolated contract-review-tier subagent at effort xhigh. The stale whole-table counts and the `knowledge_source` row are #37740's, not this PR's.

### Card question (a): does 全部类型 still list `datasource`?

Yes. Read on the booted showcase (this branch): `/studio/com.example.showcase/metadata` draws a Datasource tile linking to `/apps/setup/metadata/datasource` (`DirectoryPage.tsx`, `href={host && e.type === 'datasource' ? SETUP_DATASOURCES_PATH : undefined}`), because `scopeDirectoryEntries` hides only `field`, `package` and `form`. This matches ADR-0084: the amendment's sentence is "**The menu draws no `datasource` row**", about the menu alone; the directory keeps one entry for the type in 平台 Platform (one type, one group), and the tile leads to Setup, so a connection is still managed in Setup alone and nowhere in Studio. No mismatch to report; the directory is unchanged, as the claim requires.

## Tests

- `studioMenuModel.test.ts`: a new block "the menu draws no datasource row" — on a package, `~org` and `~all`, with `setupDirectory` true and false, a served, counted, settled `datasource` draws no entry and no entry leads to Setup's Datasources page, while `api` and `external_catalog` beside it do; a package whose only `system` type is `datasource` draws 平台 Platform with diagnostics alone, in the fold; on `~org`/`~all` it leaves no 平台 Platform group. The package-scope keys test is rewritten on purpose (`system: ['diagnostics']`), marked in a comment.
- `studioMenuPlacement.test.ts`: the registry pin reads "every listable type has one row, unless the menu draws no row for it"; a new pin says `datasource` is registered `system`, the directory lists it, and it has no row; the 高级 order literal drops it; a new 平台 Platform group pin; the ADR pin passes against the table as this PR leaves it.
- Local, from `ui/`, under the verify lock: `npx vitest run packages/app-shell/src/views/studio-design/` — `Test Files 280 passed (280)`, `Tests 2322 passed (2322)`, `VERDICT command-exit 0`. `studioMenuPlacement.test.ts` alone on the final ADR text: 19 of 19, `VERDICT command-exit 0`.

## Acceptance notes

- Two ADR-0084 sentences outside the table become dated history rather than live text, left as is (the card says no other ADR text): line ~463, "`datasource`'s and `form`'s still wait for their changes", and the 2026-11-25 silent item 1's order "`translation` · `api` · `datasource` · `external_catalog`". Both now point at, or are superseded by, the new note under the table. carrier: none — noted, not filed.

## Verification

Read first, by risk:
1. `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/studio-design/studioMenuModel.ts`, `buildStudioMenu`: the one `continue` on `STUDIO_MENU_NO_ROW_TYPES`.
2. `docs/adr/0084-application-builder-information-architecture.md`, the 平台 Platform rows and the new note.
3. `studioMenuPlacement.test.ts`: `LISTABLE_TYPES` now excludes the no-row set.

Two-minute check: `cd ui && npx vitest run packages/app-shell/src/views/studio-design/studioMenuPlacement.test.ts packages/app-shell/src/views/studio-design/studioMenuModel.test.ts` — both pass.

Browser (showcase booted from this branch, `ui/` console over HMR, seeded admin): the showcase holds two datasources (`default`, `showcase_external`; `GET /api/v1/meta/datasource` 200). On `/studio/com.example.showcase/metadata/object` with the 高级 fold open, 平台 Platform reads Documentation 8 · Documentation Book 1 · Email Template 1 · API Endpoint 3 · Diagnostics, and no Datasources row; no other group lists it either. The screenshot is kept with the project thread (`card-37920/studio-menu-platform.png`).
